get.description: 列出已发布公共文库、版本及卷册范围。先选择文库再查原文。

post.description: 检索原文候选。exact 为规范化精确匹配，cooccurrence 为 2–5 个空格分隔关键词共现；near_text 为有编辑距离校验的近似定位，必须指定 scope。串行调用，限流后遵守 retry_after_seconds，最多重试三次。

items.description: start/end are Unicode character offsets in text (end exclusive), not UTF-16 offsets.
Original page fragments retained as layout-match evidence; offsets refer to the full raw page.
